name: io.github.tonyyang0504/onbuy-mcp
description: OnBuy (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders, mark_shippe

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ONBUY_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Consumer key from the OnBuy/OnCommerce Seller Control Panel > Integrations > OnBuy API (Test and Live keys differ).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ONBUY_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret key from the same page; exchanged with the consumer key at POST /v2/auth/request-token for a 15-minute access token (bound to the calling IP), sent as the raw Authorization header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ONBUY_SITE_ID
environmentVariables.description: OnBuy site id your listings/orders belong to: 2000 = OnBuy UK (GET /v2/sites lists the others).
